title: fairBERTs: Erasing Sensitive Information Through Semantic and Fairness-aware Perturbations

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating fairness metrics (Demographic Parity Difference, Equal Opportunity Difference, Disparate Impact Ratio) and Counterfactual Token Fairness (CTF) on Jigsaw Toxicity and Yelp Sentiment datasets annotated for gender; analyzing the reduction of gender-specific words in model decision-making using LIME.
Qualitative demonstration of prediction changes in toxicity detection when swapping religiously sensitive terms (e.g., 'Muslim' to 'Christian') in input sentences.
Analysis of model reliance on sensitive identity terms, including words like 'gay' and 'transsexual', as part of the top important decision words identified by LIME.
